intro.text: 周六轻量版：8 位 builders、18 条推文。Sottiaux 三连：「按钮今天已经按过了，庆祝顺延到明天」（**6802 赞，今日最高**）+「团队从未如此火力全开」（3372 赞）+「下午 2:30 落地」（1877 赞）——重置悬念拉满。Nikunj 的实验室开战分析（51 赞）：大实验室打架不可避免，补贴 token 价格六个月内上涨、算力短缺被「真正」感受到、重置限额再见——长期利好客户选择，短期给所有开放 harness 加 10-300 亿美元估值。Rauchg 的 DM 哲学（1983 赞）+ fx 0.0.7 大幅改进 MCP（238 赞）。Zara 的产品同质化观察（6 赞）+ 东京 10 周建造计划（198 赞）。Turck 引 Ryan Greenblatt：所有前沿实验室都在做 RSI，最早 2028 底-2029 可能 AI 接管（27 赞）。播客位为 Max Hodak 一期重播（本刊 08-22 期已完整收录）。

sections.title: Button Already Pressed & Labs at War / 按钮已按与实验室开战
sections.desc: Sottiaux 的顺延庆祝（**6802 赞，今日最高**）+ 团队开火（3372 赞）+ 落地时间（1877 赞）；Nikunj 的实验室开战与 token 涨价预言（51 赞）+ 抵制 dunking（94 赞）+ 字母积木（24 赞）。

rewrite: Sottiaux's triple: the celebration postponed (6802 likes, top of the day): 'This celebration is moved to tomorrow as the button was already pressed today' — after days of teasing about finding the 20-years-unpressed reset button; plus 'Team is cooking like never before' (3372 likes) and the flight tracker 'Landing 2:30pm PST' (1877 likes) — something big seems to be landing, literally.

Nikunj's war analysis (51 likes): 'The big model labs are fighting.. this was inevitable. Watch as subsidized token prices go up in <6 months as price of compute and shortages start being "actually" felt. Say goodbye to your reset limits. Great for customer choice in the long run. And add another $1-30B in valuation to all the open harnesses in the short run 😅' Plus his anti-dunking wisdom (94 likes) and the alphabet blocks with his kid (24 likes).

rewrite: Sottiaux 三连：顺延庆祝（6802 赞，今日最高）——「这项庆祝活动改到明天，因为按钮今天已经被按过了」（此前连日预告要找到那个二十年没按的重置键）；「团队从未如此火力全开」（3372 赞）；以及航班动态式预告「下午 2:30 PST 落地」（1877 赞）——看起来真有大东西要落地了，字面意义上的。

sections.title: Every DM Read, fx 0.0.7 & Product Sameness / 每条 DM 都读、fx 0.0.7 与产品同质化
sections.desc: Rauchg 的 DM 哲学（**1983 赞**）+ fx 0.0.7（238 赞）；Zara 的产品同质化（6 赞）+ 权限疲劳（0 赞）+ 东京十周（198 赞）；Peter Yang 的云端 2FA 怪感（42 赞）+ 配偶差事 bot（43 赞）+ 奶爸省钱（2 赞）；Nan Yu 的 mentats（13 赞）。

rewrite: Rauchg's DM philosophy (1983 likes): 'I read every DM people send me, even if I don't reply to all. I'm constantly learning about new ideas, ways to improve our product, where we're falling short, who could join our company next, where to invest… very grateful for the @x platform.' And fx 0.0.7 (238 likes): hugely improved MCP support, eval'd with top MCPs like Context7, Datadog, MongoDB, Linear, Notion, Supabase, Neon, Stagehand, Kernel; more minimalist with fewer tools and improved shell execution — 'One of the trickiest things about CLI agents is that running commands is actually not that simple. Commands might hang or run for very [long].' Zara's trio: AI product sameness (6 likes) — 'Never had so many AI products looked so similar… every time I open this app it feels like homework'; permission fatigue (0 likes) — every product asks for Gmail Calendar Notion Granola Github Slack; and the Tokyo opportunity (198 likes): 10 weeks building in Tokyo and learning the Japan AI ecosystem.

Peter Yang's trio: the weird feeling of entering 2FA into a cloud computer (42 likes); the most useful @bot — 'errands your spouse wants you to run but you delegated to a bot instead' (43 likes); and 'Cheap dad all the way' (2 likes). Nan Yu's Dune reference (13 likes): 'we're gonna need mentats aren't we.'
original: Guillermo Rauch: I read every DM people send me, even if I don't reply to all. I'm constantly learning about new ideas, ways to improve our product, where we're falling short, who could join our company next, where to invest… very grateful for the @x platform.

Guillermo Rauch: fx 0.0.7: hugely improved MCP support, eval'd with top MCPs like @context7ai, @datadoghq, @mongodb, @linear, @notionhq, @supabase, @neondatabase, @stagehanddev, @usekernel… One of the trickiest things about CLI agents is that running commands is actually not that simple.
Zara Zhang: Never had so many AI products looked so similar. Even though the number of products is exploding, there aren't that many radical new ideas and everything blurs into each other.
Zara Zhang: Also every product asks for my Gmail Calendar Notion Granola Github Slack....
Zara Zhang: Great opportunity to spend 10 weeks building in Tokyo & learn the Japan AI ecosystem!
Peter Yang: tbh It's a really weird feeling entering 2FA into a cloud computer.
Peter Yang: I just came up with the most useful @bot but 'errands your spouse wants you to run but you delegated to a bot instead' is too long of a name.
Nan Yu: we're gonna need mentats aren't we.

rewrite: Rauchg 的 DM 哲学（1983 赞）：人们发给我的每条 DM 我都读，即便不全都回复——我持续从中学到新想法、产品怎么改进、哪里做得不够、下一个该加入公司的人是谁、该往哪投资……非常感谢 X 这个平台。fx 0.0.7（238 赞）：大幅改进的 MCP 支持——用 Context7、Datadog、MongoDB、Linear、Notion、Supabase、Neon、Stagehand、Kernel 等顶级 MCP 做过 eval；更极简：更少工具、更好的 shell 执行——CLI agent 最棘手的事情之一是「跑命令其实没那么简单」，比如命令可能挂起或跑很久。Zara 三连：产品同质化（6 赞）——从未有这么多 AI 产品看起来如此相似，产品数量爆炸但激进的新点子没那么多，一切糊成一片；每次打开这个 app 都像做作业：又一个要学的新产品，承诺做同样的事但「更好」，不投几小时根本说不清好在哪。权限疲劳（0 赞）——每个产品都要我的 Gmail、日历、Notion、Granola、GitHub、Slack……东京机会（198 赞）：去东京建造十周、了解日本 AI 生态。
Peter Yang 三连：在云电脑里输 2FA 真是很怪的感觉（42 赞）；想出了最有用的 bot——「配偶想让你跑的差事但你甩给了 bot」，可惜名字太长（43 赞）；以及「奶爸省钱党一路走到底」（2 赞）。Nan Yu 的沙丘梗（13 赞）：我们终将需要门泰特（代替计算机的人类心智），不是吗。
original: Rauchg：每条 DM 都读。fx 0.0.7 改进 MCP 与 shell 执行。
Zara：AI 产品前所未有地相似。权限疲劳。东京十周建造。
Yang：云端 2FA 很怪。配偶差事 bot 名字太长。
Nan Yu：我们终将需要门泰特。

sections.title: RSI Timelines & Model Recalcitrance / RSI 时间线与模型不合作
sections.desc: Turck 引 Ryan Greenblatt：RSI 或致 2028 底-2029 AI 接管（27 赞）；Dan Shipper 的解法（17 赞）与好文推荐（45 赞）。

rewrite: Matt Turck flags the RSI timeline (27 likes): 'All frontier AI labs are basically working on the same thing: recursive self improvement (RSI), meaning AI building AI. This could lead to an AI takeover as early as late 2028 or 2029, says @RyanGreenblatt.' Dan Shipper's counterpoint (17 likes): 'not an expert, but it seems like a lot of this gets solved if models don't collaborate willingly and/or are trained to report bad behavior' — plus his link of interest (45 likes): 'very interesting post and perspective.'
original: Matt Turck: All frontier AI labs are basically working on the same thing: recursive self improvement (RSI), meaning AI building AI. This could lead to an AI takeover as early as late 2028 or 2029, says @RyanGreenblatt.
Dan Shipper: not an expert, but it seems like a lot of this gets solved if models don't collaborate willingly and/or are trained to report bad behavior.
Dan Shipper: very interesting post and perspective.

rewrite: Turck 标记 RSI 时间线（27 赞）：所有前沿 AI 实验室本质上在做同一件事——递归自我改进（RSI），即 AI 造 AI。Ryan Greenblatt 说：这最早可能导致 2028 年底或 2029 年的 AI 接管。Dan Shipper 的反方观点（17 赞）：不是专家，但这些问题里的大部分似乎可以这样解决——让模型不愿自愿合谋，和/或被训练成会报告不良行为。外加一篇好文推荐（45 赞）：非常有趣的文章与视角。
original: Turck：所有实验室都在做 RSI，最早 2028-2029 AI 接管。
Shipper：让模型不合谋、训练它们举报，问题大半可解。

sections.desc: No Priors 的 Science 公司创始人 Max Hodak 一期在 feed 中重播（与 2026-08-22 期相同，2026-08-20 发布）。完整 transcript（37894 字符）译文随卡附上。

cards.authorTag: Max Hodak（Science 创始人 CEO，前 Neuralink）· 重播

rewrite: A re-run in today's feed: No Priors' conversation with Science founder/CEO Max Hodak (originally covered in our 2026-08-22 issue) — Prima retinal prosthesis with European marketing approval helping blind patients see again; the brain very literally is a computer (the skull IS the brain-in-a-vat); engineering beats drug discovery's card-flipping; the platonic representation hypothesis linking AI internals to neural recordings; 'I'm going to be ultimately fairly disappointed if I'm murdered by my pancreas'; the 10-bits-per-second cognitive bottleneck; and the long game of substrate independence and adapting to hard vacuum for the stars.
original: Max Hodak: The brain very literally, very clearly, plainly is a computer… We talk about being a brain in a vat. That's what the skull is.
Max Hodak: People forget that the moonshot worked. Like, we left boot prints on the moon.
Max Hodak: It feels like a law of physics. Like, if you apply enough compute to matter, you get this thing that looks like intelligence.
Max Hodak: I'm gonna be ultimately fairly disappointed if I'm murdered by my pancreas.

rewrite: 今日 feed 播客位为重播：No Priors 与 Science 公司创始人 Max Hodak（前 Neuralink）的对话（本刊 2026-08-22 期已完整收录，2026-08-20 发布）。核心看点：Prima 视网膜假体获欧洲上市批准、患者做数独读书；「人们忘了登月计划成功了」；头骨就是缸中之脑的缸；柏拉图表征假设——「给物质施加足够算力就得到智能，像物理定律」；「如果死于胰腺我会相当失望」；10 bit/秒认知瓶颈；基座独立与适应太空真空。完整译文见下。
original: 【开场：大脑就是计算机】
Hodak：大脑非常字面、非常清楚、非常明白地就是一台计算机。我们谈论「缸中之脑」——头骨就是那个缸。大脑通过少量导线与外界相连：颅神经和脊神经。如果你能把视觉、听觉、平衡、运动信号的进出打通，这本身就是目的本身。
【Prima：眼睛的人工耳蜗】
Hodak：Prima 是一枚植入视网膜后方的小芯片，面向因感光细胞死亡而致盲的患者。患者佩戴带激光投影仪的眼镜，把图像投到植入体上，绕过死去的视杆视锥细胞直接刺激视网膜。7 月拿到欧洲上市批准。临床试验里，患者在做数独、填字游戏、读书——以前从来没有人能以这种方式在盲人患者的「心眼」里恢复形视觉。
Hodak：为什么这比制药强？药物研发十年、临床试验翻一张牌，答案可能是不。而大脑是计算机：人工耳蜗开机、深脑刺激器开机、四肢瘫痪者植入运动皮层一小时后打游戏——药物里你看不到这种事。
【登月计划成功了】
Hodak：大家把 BCI 当成十年后才可能成的登月项目。可人们忘了登月计划成功了——我们在月球上留了鞋印。硅谷把 moonshot 当成「赔率极长、多半不成」的代名词，但历史上登月计划的成功率比人们以为的高。
【柏拉图表征假设】
Hodak：观察大模型内部，那些数学对象与神经科学里看到的非常相似。我们在 Science 拿动物脑神经记录与 AI 模型内部表征做对齐。这让我确信 AI 在正确的轨道上：宇宙有某种事实，让这些学习中的系统抓住了真实的底层数据流形。感觉像物理定律：给物质施加足够算力，你就得到看起来像智能的东西。今天做神经科学最肥沃的方式大概就是做 AI。
【胰腺、基座独立与群星】
Hodak：构成「你」的器官里唯一原则上无法移植的是大脑。心脏、胰腺、肝、肺在我看来都是配角。如果我们终将被生物谋杀，我会相当失望自己死于胰腺。两大死因——心血管疾病和脑转移癌——我认为都能通过这类工作真正攻克。
Hodak：如果二十年后我们成功了，人类处境的改变是：那种固有的脆弱与风险感会消退，我们将能升级和更换自己的部件。适应硬真空太空，长期看正是我们要做的。说到底，那是同一个项目：可更换的部件，与基座独立。
